notes: Request profiles that the eval harnesses send, used by the eval-readiness probes (P2 run_harness_requests, P4 run_long_answer_load, P5 run_long_context).
request holds OpenAI request fields as the harness sends them. max_tokens is the harness budget; probes cap it to their own output length.
thinking: true asks for thinking mode (the probe adds the model's chat-template switch), false asks for it off, null leaves the template default.
request_from: hf_generation_config means the request is built at run time from the checkpoint's generation_config.json (see eval_request_profiles.py).
Refresh the values when the TTI eval configs or the pinned lm-eval fork change; record the source of each change.

profiles.name: plain
profiles.source: probe baseline: greedy, no seed, no top_k; every device sampler serves it

profiles.name: lm_eval_reasoning
profiles.source: lm-eval fork tstescoTT/lm-evaluation-harness@321e3bb6 lm_eval/tasks/r1_evals/gpqa_reasoning_diamond.yaml generation_kwargs (top_k 40, top_p 0.95, n 1, max_gen_toks 32768); tenstorrent/tt-inference-server reference_config/evals/eval_config.py EvalTask r1_gpqa_diamond gen_kwargs override temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, until [] (IFM/K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B, google/gemma-4-* entries, use_chat_api=True); llm_module/eval_command.py _inject_seed_into_gen_kwargs adds seed 42 (EvalTask.seed); lm_eval/models/openai_completions.py LocalChatCompletion._create_payload drops do_sample and maps max_gen_toks to max_tokens

profiles.name: lm_eval_non_reasoning
profiles.source: lm-eval fork tstescoTT/lm-evaluation-harness@321e3bb6 lm_eval/tasks/ifeval/ifeval.yaml generation_kwargs (temperature 0.0, max_gen_toks 1280, until []); tt-inference-server EvalTask defaults use_chat_api=False (local-completions with client-side chat template) and seed 42 propagated by eval_command.py _inject_seed_into_gen_kwargs; LocalCompletionsAPI._create_payload sends seed, temperature and max_tokens

profiles.name: model_card
profiles.source: the checkpoint's generation_config.json, read at run time. vLLM (--generation-config auto, the default) applies the same keys to requests that omit them: temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, repetition_penalty, max_new_tokens

profiles.name: agentic
profiles.source: tt-inference-server reference_config/evals/eval_config.py TerminalBenchEvalConfig, Harbor agent terminus-2 agent_kwargs for IFM/K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B: temperature 1.0, llm_kwargs top_p 0.95 and max_tokens 32768, interleaved_thinking true (reasoning_content sent back in history); Harbor sends no seed and no top_k unless llm_kwargs or extra_body set one
